procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ESP 56971 was represented by Amalia Coll Company.
TUR 57632 was represented by Can Çaçcur.
Jacobo Garcia, coach of ESP 56971, attended the hearing as an observer.
Cem Aydin, coach of TUR 57632, attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: At the time of the incident, the conditions were 12 knots of wind and waves of one metre.
At the start ESP 56971 on starboard tack and TUR 57632 on port tack were sailing on a converging course.
At a distance of 1 metre between the boats, ESP 56971 bore away and passed the stern of TUR 57632 at a distance of 20 centimetres.
If ESP 56971 had held her course, contact would have occurred between the bow of ESP 56971 and the starboard side of TUR 57632 on the aft part of the hull.
conclusions: TUR 57632 on port tack failed to keep clear of ESP 56971 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
